metadata.question: Were there fires in Pedrógão Grande during the any time between June 16 to June 20, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Fire CCI (MCD64A1, burned area) or MODIS FIRMS active fire (MODIS/006/MOD14A1). 16-day composite vs. daily detect. Since the window is 5 days, FIRMS active fire (daily 1km) better signals presence/absence. Collection: `MODIS/006/FIRMS` band ‘FireMask’ (values≠7 are active fire confidence). Location: Pedrógão Grande, Portugal ≈ (-8.13, 39.92). Buffer 15 km to be safe. Time: 2017-06-16 → 2017-06-20 inclusive. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud mask needed (it’s a fire confidence product). We simply count pixels with fire (FireMask < 7). 3. Logic: - If collection size ==0 → C1 - After clipping to buffer, if count of fire pixels ==0 → no fire observed (B) - Else → at least one fire pixel → A - Any None/NaN in the result → C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') roi = ee.Geometry.Point([-8.13, 39.92]).buffer(15000) start, end = '2017-06-16', '2017-06-20' col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/FIRMS')\ .filterDate(start, end)\ .filterBounds(roi) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No FIRMS images found.") print("C1") exit() fireMask = col.select('FireMask').mosaic().clip(roi) firePix = fireMask.lt(7) count = firePix.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('FireMask').getInfo() if count is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") elif count == 0: print(f"No active-fire pixels detected in {n} FIRMS images.") print("B") else: print(f"Active-fire pixels: {int(count)} in {n} images.") print("A") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

roi = ee.Geometry.Point([-8.13, 39.92]).buffer(15000)
start, end = '2017-06-16', '2017-06-20'

col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/FIRMS')\
        .filterDate(start, end)\
        .filterBounds(roi)

n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No FIRMS images found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

fireMask = col.select('FireMask').mosaic().clip(roi)
firePix = fireMask.lt(7)

count = firePix.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9).get('FireMask').getInfo()

if count is None:
    print("Calculation returned None.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif count == 0:
    print(f"No active-fire pixels detected in {n} FIRMS images.")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Active-fire pixels: {int(count)} in {n} images.")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
